Frequently asked questions

q: Can I embed a Post that contains a photo, video, or other media?

runs: Yes! An embedded Post can display photos and videos uploaded to >x< as well as content described by a link.

q: What if the Post I want to embed is part of a conversation (a reply)?

runs: When the embedded Post is a reply, the parent Post will be displayed above the reply. A permalink will be available on both Posts to the reply, and a link to the replier’s profile will be available on the reply.
Check the Hide Conversation checkbox when setting customization options on
to hide the parent Post.

q: Can I embed a Post from someone who chooses to protect their Posts?

runs: Embed code is not available for Posts from people who choose to protect their Posts.

q: What if someone deletes a Post, changes their Posts from public to protected, or the account becomes suspended after the Post has been embedded on another website?

runs: Text content of the Post will still be visible, but media will not be loaded by >x<'s JavaScript.
